stage: Hero-to-introduction visual prototype; broader choreography and device performance sign-off pending
contract: README.md: compact chess-led hero with procedural board, matched fallback, bounded scroll/pointer movement and layered parallax. No extra page length. Other homepage choreography waits for visual approval.

accessibility.evidence: Decorative artwork has zero focus targets. Tab from Explore tournaments reaches Meet the Trust with a 3px outline. Phone menu opens; Escape closes, restores Menu focus and clears body overflow. Pointer observation does not capture input. Eligibility tests cover reduced motion, touch and data restrictions; actual browser preference changes remain explicitly untested.

responsive.evidence: Desktop knight/board fit below navbar and above discovery link. Tablet/phone use the matching image with zero canvases/no Lenis. Client and scroll widths match at 1425, 819 and 375. Desktop-to-tablet resize reverts inline transforms and destroys enhancement. No section height or page length was added.

loading.evidence: Reload observations begin static/loading with the bundled image and HTML actions; production reaches one ready canvas. Image/canvas handoff waits for a valid rendered frame. Cold-start timing was not benchmarked.

empty.reason: Bundled decorative artwork is not a user collection; missing geometry is handled by the local failure fallback.

error.evidence: Temporarily missing model returned HTTP 404 while fallback returned 200. Browser retained loaded board image and actions with zero canvases/no Lenis. Model restored before production checks.

partial.evidence: Failure and narrow layouts retain complete copy, navigation, both actions and matching artwork while enhancement is absent.

success.evidence: One ready canvas on desktop and production. Recorded downward/upward scroll reverses to zero. Temporary counters stop at rest/offscreen; route checks remove canvas/Lenis on Events and restore one canvas on Home.

permission.reason: Public decorative scene requests no account or device permission. Existing source attribution is retained.
